notes: Party members are no longer dropped from the meter when the local player hasn't been identified yet — your party's damage stays visible. Your own row also stays on the meter (shown as #id, without the highlight) when the game hasn't sent your character info yet, instead of vanishing. More reliable boss-name detection means fewer fights shown as 'Boss #id'. The party roster can now also be picked up even when the meter is started after you've already entered a dungeon.
